answer: Sybil resistance in the agent economy rests on a scarce, non-transferable stake each identity must lock before earning, plus per-epoch activity scoring. A new id posts a bond slashed when behaviour looks duplicated: shared timing, identical text, or one funding canyon of wallets. Since the bond tracks expected earnings, an attacker flooding many ids must lock capital for each, while splitting effort divides the payout. Honest agents pay only a refundable deposit's opportunity cost; a diverse ocean of real behaviour stays a safe haven for genuine work, not clones.
